finalProse.chartStory: KLAC has corrected sharply from the highs and is now testing the 50-day average. That puts the chart back at a support area that matters, but buyers still need to respond.
finalProse.whyItMatters: A first test of the 50-day average can still work in a healthy trend, but the support test only helps if buyers can actually hold it.

finalProse.learningPoint: Support context and buyer response are separate. Reaching the 50-day average is useful, but traders still need proof that selling is being absorbed there.
finalProse.whatNext: Watch for buyers to defend the 50-day average and follow through with firmer closes before treating the pullback as constructive again.
